title: Cutting off the king
line: A rook on the file between keeps the defending king away from the pawn.

steps.text: Black's king wants to reach the pawn and stand in front of it. A rook on the file between them shuts it out.
A king cannot step onto a square the rook guards. Here, kept a file away, it cannot help, and your king walks the pawn up.
Cut the black king off: put your rook on the file between it and the pawn.

also.c4b5: That also keeps the game in hand: the black king is still too far. This lesson cuts it off with the rook.
